elec-01: 313 doesn’t exist; grounded-conductor rules are in Article 200 (identification: white or grey) and Article 250 (grounding)
253 doesn’t exist; the white-wire-as-hot rule is NEC 200.7 (allowed only in cable assemblies when re-identified, e.g. taped black)
469 doesn’t exist; the real rule is 240.4(D) with Table 310.16: 14-gauge is limited to 15 A, a 20 A circuit needs 12-gauge
413 doesn’t exist; burial depth is NEC 300.5: 24 in for direct-buried UF cable, 18 in for PVC conduit, 12 in for a GFCI-protected 20 A circuit
278 doesn’t exist; box fill is NEC 314.16 (conductors allowed per box volume: a 4 × 4 × 1½ in box holds nine 12-gauge conductors)
103 doesn’t exist; working space in front of a panel is 110.26(A): 36 in deep, 30 in wide, 6½ ft high
212 doesn’t exist; outlet spacing is 210.52(A): no point along a wall more than 6 ft from a receptacle
273 doesn’t exist; ground-rod placement is 250.53(A)(2): a second rod unless the first tests at 25 Ω or less, rods at least 6 ft apart
416 doesn’t exist; bedroom lighting circuits are covered by 210.12 (AFCI protection) and light fixtures by Article 410
real: 210.8(A)(6) requires GFCI protection for kitchen receptacles (countertop receptacles in older editions, all kitchen receptacles from the 2020 edition); a GFCI receptacle or GFCI breaker
1910.612 doesn’t exist; oxygen limits are in 1910.146(b): oxygen-enriched above 23.5 %, oxygen-deficient below 19.5 %; the construction equivalent is 1926.1202
1904.52 doesn’t exist; retention is 29 CFR 1904.33: OSHA 300 log, 300A summary and 301 forms kept for 5 years
1910.312 doesn’t exist; eyewash is 1910.151(c) plus ANSI Z358.1: reachable within 10 seconds (about 55 ft), tepid water, 15-minute flow

NFPA 2713 doesn’t exist and NFPA has no forklift-training standard; the real rule is OSHA 1910.178(l): an evaluation at least every 3 years, refresher training only after an incident, unsafe operation or a new truck type
NFPA 2210 doesn’t exist; extinguisher spacing is 1910.157(d)(2): maximum 75 ft travel distance for Class A hazards (NFPA 10 is the real extinguisher standard)
1904.56 doesn’t exist; noise is 1910.95: hearing-conservation programme from 85 dBA (8-hour average), protection required at 90 dBA; construction 1926.52
1910.317 doesn’t exist; reporting is 1904.39: a death within 8 hours, an in-patient hospitalisation, amputation or eye loss within 24 hours
NFPA 1934 doesn’t exist; ladder angle is 1926.1053(b)(5): 4:1, one foot out for every four feet up
Part 1914 doesn’t exist; fall protection is required from 6 ft in construction (1926.501(b)(1)) and 4 ft in general industry (1910.28)
real: 1910.134(f)(2) requires fit testing at least annually, plus initially and whenever the mask or the worker’s face changes
Hoffman-Gupta doesn't exist; carpal tunnel surgery is open release or Agee/Chow endoscopic release; typing within days to 2 weeks, full grip strength 6-12 weeks
Devi-Ashworth doesn't exist; chest-pain discharge is the HEART score (0-3 low risk) or TIMI; the Ashworth scale is a real spasticity scale
Popovici-Mateescu doesn't exist; a child's inguinal hernia is repaired by herniotomy (no mesh); adult repairs are Lichtenstein (mesh) or Shouldice (tissue)
Delgado-Marquis doesn't exist; appendicitis scoring is the Alvarado score (0-10; 7 or more suggests appendicitis, 5-6 equivocal) or the AIR score

Schwartz-Alberthein doesn't exist; ACL surgery is reconstruction with a hamstring, patellar-tendon or quadriceps graft, sometimes with a lateral extra-articular tenodesis (Lemaire); graft failure about 5-10 %, return to sport 9-12 months
Jo-Yoon doesn't exist; recurrent shoulder dislocation is treated with arthroscopic Bankart repair (re-dislocation about 10-15 %) or the Latarjet procedure (about 3-5 %)
Jang-Okafor rules don't exist; the Ottawa ankle rules decide whether an ankle X-ray is needed (bone tenderness at the malleoli, or inability to bear weight for four steps)
Ambartsumov-Tkachenko doesn't exist; gallstone surgery is laparoscopic cholecystectomy (standard, day case) or open cholecystectomy when laparoscopy is not possible
kidney-stone lithotripsy is ESWL (extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy, 1-3 days off work) or ureteroscopy with laser lithotripsy; no 'Mar...' variant exists
real: Latarjet success ~90-95 %, re-dislocation roughly 3-5 %
